Tagcast 0.10.1 improves the standalone downloads while keeping the browser
interface and the metadata, playback and trash workflows from 0.10.0.

## Desktop downloads

- **macOS:** a `Tagcast.app` with the existing Tagcast icon, for both Apple Silicon and Intel. Extract it and move it to Applications.
- **Windows:** extract the whole folder and open `Tagcast.exe`; no console window is needed.
- **Linux:** extract `tagcast-0.10.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` and open `Tagcast` inside the extracted folder.
- A small launcher opens your browser and lets you stop the local server it started. Closing it never stops an already-running instance started elsewhere.
- A separate `tagcast-cli` (`tagcast-cli.exe` on Windows) supports `--open`, `--port`, `--help` and `--version`.
- Python, Tk, dependencies and frontend assets are bundled. No Python installation is needed for these downloads.
- Every native archive has a SHA-256 checksum. Builds test both executables after extraction and check HTTP assets, access guards and macOS bundle signatures.

Keep Windows/Linux executables and their `_internal` folder together. The apps
are not Developer ID/notarized or Authenticode signed. If blocked, use macOS
**Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, or Windows **More info → Run anyway**.

## Updating

Stop the old Tagcast before opening 0.10.1; otherwise the new launcher opens
that running instance. Settings, tokens and cache remain in `~/.tagcast/`, or
`TAGCAST_HOME`. Your music files are never modified.

Source installations and start scripts remain available with Python 3.11+ or uv.
See [native build instructions](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.10.1/docs/native-builds.md)
for checksums, CLI usage, platform coverage and build procedures.
